title: Setup: build Spring Framework spring-core at both #36911 revisions and run PropertyTests
description: Setup for Brief A3, no claims. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/spring-java-data/src, builds spring-core at f067d40f (landed) and fd95ab16 (parent) with Gradle 9.7.0 and the JDK 25 toolchain (Temurin 25.0.5, auto-download off), runs the landed PropertyTests (new in this change) on the landed side, and the same file transplanted onto the parent, where resolveNameForRecordAccessorEmbeddingGetPrefix is expected to fail (the transplant is removed after). Jars to .../artifacts with sha256, runtime classpath to .../logs, landed tests rerun --offline, build trees removed. Results go into llm-dlc/loops/spring-and-java-data-setup.md.
expected: every step exits 0: landed PropertyTests all pass; on the parent the Gradle test task fails and the junit summary lists PropertyTests#resolveNameForRecordAccessorEmbeddingGetPrefix among the failures; offline rerun BUILD SUCCESSFUL

resources.notes: Gradle -Xmx2048m plus a Kotlin daemon and the test JVM; first run downloads the Framework 7.1 build's dependencies

steps.name: spring-framework-36911-landed: build spring-core, run PropertyTests
spring-framework-36911-parent: build spring-core, run the landed PropertyTests (transplanted; failures expected)
spring-framework-36911-landed: PropertyTests offline
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; B=$HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/spring-java-data; export GRADLE_USER_HOME=$B/gradle-home TMPDIR=$B/tmp; mkdir -p $B/tmp $B/logs $B/artifacts; export JAVA_HOME=$HOME/.sdkman/candidates/java/25.0.5.0+8-tem; G="./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain -Porg.gradle.java.installations.auto-download=false -Porg.gradle.java.installations.paths=$HOME/.sdkman/candidates/java/25.0.5.0+8-tem"; cd $B/src/spring-framework-36911-landed; $G --offline :spring-core:test --tests 'org.springframework.core.convert.PropertyTests' --rerun 2>&1 | tee $B/logs/spring-framework-36911-landed.spring-core.offline-test.log | tail -5; grep -q 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL' $B/logs/spring-framework-36911-landed.spring-core.offline-test.log

steps.name: remove the build trees
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; B=$HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/spring-java-data; export GRADLE_USER_HOME=$B/gradle-home TMPDIR=$B/tmp; mkdir -p $B/tmp $B/logs $B/artifacts; git -C $B/src/spring-framework-36911-parent clean -fdxq; git -C $B/src/spring-framework-36911-parent status --short | wc -l; git -C $B/src/spring-framework-36911-landed clean -fdxq; git -C $B/src/spring-framework-36911-landed status --short | wc -l; du -sh $B/src
